Watch The Evergreen Kannada Melody “Hosa Belaku Mooduthide” From The Classic Kannada Movie Hosa Belaku, Starring Dr. Rajkumar And Saritha, With Music Composed By M. Ranga Rao.
Relive The Golden Era Of Kannada Cinema With This Beautiful Video Song And Enjoy The Timeless Magic Of Kannada Film Music.
Kannada Video Songs, Old Movie Hits, And Memorable Melodies.
Movie: Hosa Belaku
Directed by: Dorai - Bhagwan
Produced by: S. A. Srinivas, Sadanand, Rajashekar, Shivaram
Artist Name: Dr. Rajkumar, Saritha, Srinivasa Murthy
Music Director: M. Ranga Rao
